input.sourceText: For the purposes of supporting the successful return of shared trays in a way that ensures their availability, there are a number of factors to take into consideration in determining the appropriate course of action following use. Once a tray has been washed and the desk attendant has checked it, you can put it on the open shelf. If the attendant is away, leave the washed tray on the drying rack with your name on a slip. A chipped tray goes in the marked tub even if the attendant has checked it. The attendant records chips so the next user is not blamed for damage they did not cause.

Paragraph editing example (conversational instructions, restructuring allowed)
Source
To facilitate the appropriate booking of rehearsal rooms, members may request a room before they know how many people are coming, but a booking is confirmed only once the coordinator has sent a confirmation email. Walk-in requests are accepted on Saturdays if a room is free.

If the group needs a piano, please say so in the request. A piano is available only in Room B.

Revision
If you're a member, you can request a rehearsal room before you know how many people are coming. The booking is confirmed when the coordinator sends you a confirmation email. On Saturdays, walk-in requests are accepted if a room is free.

Need a piano? Mention it in your request. Room B is the only room with a piano.

Meaning check
Members may request a room before the group size is known. Confirmation still requires the coordinator's email. Walk-ins still depend on both Saturday and availability. The final paragraph pairs the request for a piano with the room restriction.

Target style: CONVERSATIONAL. Explain directly in accessible language. Keep necessary terms and the author's relationship to the reader.
Editing depth: RESTRUCTURE. Split or combine paragraphs and reorder independent information where helpful. Preserve chronology, causal direction and the action governed by each condition.
Explicit requirements in the user JSON override style, depth and language defaults within the meaning and quotation safeguards.

重排后逐句检查下列语义边界。正文仍可改得直接、好读。
- 时间或触发事件只按原文的精度表达。当原文未明确是某事件开始、结束、批准或确认时，沿用原有时间口径。
- 保留谁做哪件事。原文只说明记录有助于后续处理，或句子未明确由谁完成某项动作时，保持这个目的或不确定性，勿为相邻主体增加承诺。
- 观察、迹象、推断和已证实的结论按原文强度表达。保留样本范围、未测项及不确定性。
- 许可保留为许可，义务与建议保留各自的强度。可以优化步骤，但保留“可”和“必须”对应的动作及前提。

When restructuring, keep the source's precision about when a condition starts or ends. Preserve the responsible party and leave unspecified responsibility unspecified. Keep suggestions, observations, qualified findings and verified conclusions at their original strength. Keep permission, advice and obligations distinct when expressing a step. polishedText:
Here's how to return a shared tray so it's ready for the next person to use.

Once you've washed the tray, the desk attendant needs to check it. After the attendant has checked it, you can put it on the open shelf.

If the attendant is away, leave the washed tray on the drying rack with your name on a slip.

A chipped tray goes in the marked tub, even if the attendant has checked it. The attendant records chips so the next user isn't blamed for damage they didn't cause.
